text: Casey (People Ops): Quick proposal  managers run 10-minute "micro-ceremonies" during calibration week where each manager hands out 2-3 fabric ribbon tokens + a verbal shoutout at team lunch. low-cost, repeatable, and ties into recognition portal. thoughts? :ribbon: Marta (HR Ops): love the sentiment. two policy items: 1) ribbons are non-cash tokens under $10 so fine, 2) we need the recognition logged so the recipient count doesn't trigger taxable thresholds. recognition-bot: Reminder  please log awards via /recognize and tag #cal-week so they flow into the monthly report. Jules (Finance): budget ok if materials + small catered lunch under GL 4102 and < $500 per manager event. if we do catered lunches org-wide that's a different approval. Casey (People Ops): plan A: managers run a 10-minute moment during their existing team lunch on July 18-22. People Ops will order 600 ribbons (3 per manager across 200 managers) and make a quick QR form. Plan B: if teams skip lunch week, we do a single pop-up celebration in the main space July 21. Terry (Managers Guild): heads-up: managers prefer clear kit + script. can we give a 30-second script and pre-printed token cards so managers don't overthink it? Casey (People Ops): yes  script and 2-card kit per token: one fabric ribbon + one code sticker linking to QR form. managers peel sticker and stick on a simple tracking sheet or scan QR and submit instantly. recognition-bot: Note  entries with #cal-week are aggregated for payroll review; portal will flag if an employee exceeds $100/year in non-cash awards. Marta (HR Ops): add an opt-out option for employees who don't want physical tokens. we must respect privacy and address-less distribution. Casey (People Ops): we'll include a checkbox in the QR form: "I prefer digital recognition only." Jules (Finance): vendor cost estimate? Casey (People Ops): vendor quote: $0.50/ribbon + $45 setup + $120 shipping => ~ $465 for 600 units. plus printing code stickers $30. total ~ $595. Jules (Finance): over $500  submit spend approval via /spend-approval and we'll route to director sign-off. Casey (People Ops): noted. action items: 1) Casey submit spend request today 2) Marta draft kit script and opt-out language 3) Terry help compile manager list + suggested cadence 4) Cory can we support small individually-bought lunches? Cory (Catering): we can provide boxed lunches at scale but need 72h lead time; per-box $8-$12 depending on menu. for manager-level lunches we recommend stipends instead of onsite catering to avoid large ordering complexity. Jules (Finance): stipends are taxable if cash; prefer non-cash token + manager-paid snack. keep stipends minimal and route through HR if cash. Casey (People Ops): ok we won't do cash stipends. final ask: team, can we pilot with 20 managers first week to validate process and tracking? Terry (Managers Guild): yes I can recruit 20 managers to pilot. Casey (People Ops): perfect. I'll post the pilot signup and spend request in #people-ops. recognition-bot: Note  pilot entries tagged #cal-week-pilot will be included in the July export. Casey (People Ops): payroll cutoff reminder  any awards needing payroll handling must be in by July 26. please escalate early. Marta (HR Ops): will review opt-outs and confirm privacy language. Jules (Finance): will review spend request when submitted. Terry (Managers Guild): thumbs up from manager cohort. excited for low-friction recognition. :raised_hands:
